description: Render and send a test message — either a saved template (`templateId` + sample `variables`) or ad-hoc `subject`/`html`. ALWAYS forced into test mode: the message renders, logs, and is fully inspectable via volanea_check_delivery, but is never delivered to a real inbox, even when authenticated with a live key. Use it to verify content renders correctly, then read it back with volanea_check_delivery.

from.description: Sender address. Defaults to the template's, or the project's verified domain.

html.description: Ad-hoc HTML body. Required unless templateId is given.

subject.description: Ad-hoc subject. Required unless templateId is given.

templateId.description: Send a saved template. Omit if providing subject/html.

to.description: Recipient address for the test. Use the address from volanea_get_project_status `testInbox` — do NOT invent one like test@theirdomain.com. Invented addresses are real domains with no such mailbox; they hard-bounce and damage sender reputation the moment anything sends to them for real.

name: volanea_send_test_email

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

emailId.description: Read it back with volanea_check_delivery to see the rendered result.

testMode.description: Always true — this tool never delivers, even with a live key.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
